verdicts.reason: A: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below the subtitle and URL, so the reading order is out of sequence. RSVP has been shrunk to the same pill as the three tags, so the CTA is buried, and the logo is a tiny fragment under the decorative circle; the headline and phone still read cleanly left to right. B: the headline has strong hierarchy, but the right half is a cramped jumble (stray subtitle and time fragments, a tiny RSVP squeezed into the tag row, illegible legal text). A large grey placeholder box also becomes a dominant focal point, so B is the messier of the two.
